scope.status: Complete first AI-assisted direct-facsimile editorial pass: all 2,495 segmented candidates reviewed; 1,965 provisional article starts accepted and diplomatically transcribed; 530 false boundaries rejected; 781 headwords corrected. Scientific note audit distinguishes 194 resolved editorial notes from 482 explicit open-validation records; independent human/philological and linguistic verification remains pending.

editorial_pipeline.rhd_fr_028_note: RHD-FR-028 directly audited all 60 curated seed anchors: all 60 are genuine article starts; 31 headwords and four page assignments were corrected; RHD-DIP-028A–F completed their diplomatic layer.
editorial_pipeline.validation_non_overwrite_policy: RHD-PHIL confirmations and proposed corrections never overwrite headword_diplomatic or article_diplomatic; independent human decisions and later normalized/critical layers must remain separately traceable.
editorial_pipeline.next_stage_priority: Continue deterministic RHD-PHIL recollation over the remaining 432 open cases while preserving a separate human-review queue; prioritize unresolved-after-AI cases for independent philological/linguistic review, then build normalization, variant and diachronic-correspondence layers without overwriting diplomatic evidence.
